name: Dragon Ball FighterZ: Dragon Ball Daima Pack
summary:
The legendary Goku (SS4) from Dragon Ball DAIMA joins the fight in DRAGON BALL FighterZ!

Content includes:

• Goku (SS4 DAIMA) as a new playable character

• 6 alternative colors for his outfit

• Goku (SS4 DAIMA) Lobby Avatar

• Vegeta (SS3) Lobby Avatar

• Panzy Lobby Avatar

• 3 Z Stamps, including Majin Duu and Majin Kuu

• 1 Player Card Header
